ECC.name: SAP ECC 6.0
ECC.note: IS-Oil Joint Venture Accounting (SIMULATED, representative names): T8JV / T8JE / T8JU ventures, equity groups and partner WI, JVSO1 JV ledger, JVPO1 cutback, T8JBH/T8JBL JIB statements, T8JCC cash calls; plus BKPF/BSEG, BSAD receipts, KNA1 partners and PROJ/PRPS/BPGE AFEs.

S4.name: SAP S/4HANA
S4.note: S/4HANA JVA: JV cost, GL and partner receipts in the Universal Journal ACDOCA (VNAME / EGRUP / RECID), cutback in JVPSC01A (simulated), BUT000 partners; T8J* configuration, JIB, cash calls and PROJ/PRPS/BPGE as in ECC.

BW.name: SAP BW/4HANA
BW.note: GL line items only (0FIGL-style ADSO with joint venture and recovery indicator). No JVA content: ventures, equity, cutback, JIB, cash calls and receipts are gaps.

BDC.name: SAP BDC
BDC.note: Zero-copy SAP BDC data products: EntryViewJournalEntry (GL with JointVenture fields), BusinessPartner and EnterpriseProjectElement (AFE master, no budget). SAP BDC has no IS-Oil JVA data products, so ventures, equity, cutback, JIB, cash calls and receipts are gaps.

PARTNER_PORTAL.name: JV partner portal (non-operator collaboration)
PARTNER_PORTAL.note: Partner-entered AFE ballots (consent / non-consent), JIB disputes with reasons and partner audit exceptions, keyed by the SAP partner, AFE and JIB numbers.

profiles.name: SAP SLT / direct replication
profiles.note: Native table and column names and types, as SAP SLT, Snowflake Openflow or a replication partner configured for native shape lands them. Today's bronze.

profiles.name: Fivetran
profiles.vendor: Fivetran (SAP ERP on HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP OData connectors)
profiles.note: Uppercase names; '/' in SAP namespaces becomes '_'. Adds _FIVETRAN_SYNCED; soft-delete mode adds _FIVETRAN_DELETED, history mode adds _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE/_START/_END, no-trigger mode _FIVETRAN_ID.

profiles.name: Qlik Replicate
profiles.vendor: Qlik Replicate / Qlik Cloud Data Integration (SAP Application, SAP HANA endpoints)
profiles.note: Native names. DATS/TIMS often land as text. Soft deletes via an operation_indicator column (default DELETE_FLAG = 'D'); Store Changes writes <table>__CT change tables with header__ columns, which are ignored.

profiles.name: Other ELT tool (configurable)
profiles.vendor: SNP Glue, Theobald Xtract, Informatica, AWS AppFlow, Azure Data Factory, ...
profiles.note: Set OPTIONS on CONFIG.INGESTION: table_prefix, audit_columns (regex), delete_column + delete_value, cast_text_types.
